review_scope: Independent research findings plus exact assembled-data resolution readback; no reviewer authorizes publication.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.topic: Per-claim provenance in a legacy single-source round
ontology_and_provenance_findings.finding: Both staged events correctly use distinct sources for the event and its currency, but a naive projection of event.source_url alongside numeric amount/currency would make the chosen source appear to support a claim that its own registry says is unspecified.

evidence.registry_observation: Osler supplies announcement/close; corrected BetaKit supplies explicit USD denomination and other participants; a16z supplies lead role.
Company release uses an unspecified dollar symbol; Reuters explicitly supplies C$68.5m.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.required_action: Preserve the explicit amount/date/role source mapping in the staging ledger and legacy note/profile facts, choose a source that actually supports the projected claim, or omit unsupported numeric currency fields. Do not collapse the mapping under a single URL without qualification.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.topic: Ceilings, secondary sales, debt facilities and lower bounds
ontology_and_provenance_findings.finding: The staging records distinguish these correctly. Projection must preserve those distinctions so financial totals do not become exact primary capital raised.

evidence.qualifier: Agreement for up to CAD425m combines CAD300m primary and up to CAD125m secondary; closing unverified. Its non-null numeric value is explicitly an upper bound.
Secondary shares above CAD500m; not primary proceeds to the company and not exact CAD500m.
Final total exceeds USD200m and includes the first close in January; no second additive round or exact USD200m amount.
USD350m debt facility size does not establish drawdown. Separate from USD500m equity and USD1bn acquisition price.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.required_action: Omit legacy numeric amount/currency for ceilings/lower bounds if the legacy display cannot express the qualifier; retain exact reported wording and transaction type. Keep debt identified as debt and avoid combined capital-raised totals across unlike transactions.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.finding: The stored counsel evidence establishes a 2025-05-29 closing day, while announcement day is explicitly unknown. A date in event_id or URL does not supply the missing announcement day.
ontology_and_provenance_findings.required_action: Leave legacy announced_on omitted. Preserve closed_on in the richer ledger and any dated narrative with its label.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.finding: The direct founder quote supports Victoria HQ as of 2024-02-27, and the same source introduction says Vancouver-based. The fragment preserves both and explicitly leaves current headquarters unresolved.
ontology_and_provenance_findings.required_action: Use a dated headquarters profile fact, including the retained conflict/currentness limit. Do not render Victoria as independently verified current HQ in an unqualified country field.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.finding: Government staged commitment and Uber milestone-based future investment are separate research-only event entries with undisclosed or unresolved numeric amounts. Neither is a second completed equity round.
ontology_and_provenance_findings.required_action: Respect projection=research_only. Do not subtract the Waabi Series C from a headline aggregate to invent a separate amount, and do not treat Cohere commitment ceiling as disbursed capital.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.finding: Natalia Karimova uses the 2021 founder mention plus a separate 2019 official caption for the full name. The fragment explicitly retains identity_source_url.
ontology_and_provenance_findings.required_action: Retain both source associations in the provenance ledger or explanatory profile fact when projecting the legacy founder object, which has only one source field.

ontology_and_provenance_findings.topic: Short investor/fund/brand names are unresolved entities
ontology_and_provenance_findings.finding: The records generally preserve named funds, managers and parent/subsidiary relations without asserting canonical investor IDs. A parser must not replace these with convenient parent-company identities or merge Neo Financial with unsourced partner:neo.
ontology_and_provenance_findings.required_action: Keep manager/fund/subsidiary wording as reported. Use event-specific evidence for any future participation role. No automatic entity merge or event-investment edge is approved.

reports.scope: Read all six East records and 22 ecosystem claims, source registries, date/amount/role annotations and coverage counters; independently reopened 14 existing East sources, five ecosystem sources and one linked investor-context PDF. This is targeted evidence review, not exhaustive revalidation of every source or a production-schema test.

findings.issue: Non-exact amounts occupy the scalar value field. dcbel is up to USD55m; CarbonCure is more than USD80m. Deep Sky reports a rounded CAD75m total while the stated cash and note-conversion components sum to CAD75.2m.

evidence.observation: CGF completed USD40m within a financing of up to USD55m; the remaining amount was prospective.
Body reports a total exceeding USD80m.
Headline total CAD75m; components CAD57.5m new capital and CAD17.7m seed-note conversion.

findings.proposed_fix: In normalized evidence set value:null for every non-exact amount. Preserve numeric_reported and upper_bound:55000000, lower_bound:80000000 or rounded_reported:75000000 with currencies, precision, operators and original components. Do not repair the Deep Sky discrepancy silently or treat note conversion as new cash.
findings.root_resolution: Agreed by root: canonicalizer will null non-exact values and preserve raw observations and bounds. Implementation verification pending.

findings.issue: The announcement describes Idealist and others as planning the additional commitment. Its participant entry has prospective status, which must survive normalization and must not become a confirmed completed investment relationship.

evidence.observation: Issuer distinguishes completed CGF investment from additional prospective investment; general investor-base names are separate.

findings.proposed_fix: Keep the prospective assertion in evidence and omit it from any completed round-participant projection until closing evidence exists. Do not infer Coatue or Volvo participation from the general backer list.
findings.root_resolution: Agreed by root: prospective status remains explicit and no production relationship is created.

findings.issue: The company blog labels 2025-10-09 as Last Updated, not publication or announcement. The independently accessed BusinessWire text contains no visible date; a date-shaped URL is not itself publication evidence. Amount, currency and named participants are supported, but the current exact-day binding is weaker than its precision suggests.

evidence.observation: The displayed date label is Last Updated on Oct 09, 2025.
Release body establishes USD50m and participants; no visible publication timestamp in the obtained text.

findings.proposed_fix: Verify an explicit primary publication/announcement timestamp and bind announced_on to it, or leave exact announcement day unresolved and retain update-date evidence separately. Keep the RBCx relative-date discrepancy without inventing a duplicate Series B.

findings.issue: Two other source registry publication dates are displayed as update dates in the pages read. This does not invalidate the alias or founder assertions but the provenance dates should distinguish updated from published.

evidence.observation: November 29, 2022 is labelled Updated; founder names appear in the company interview response.

findings.proposed_fix: Use published_on:null unless publication metadata is independently established; retain the observed date as updated_on with its explicit label. EnergySage remains a secondary-hosted interview with a direct company statement, not an anonymous directory assertion.

findings.issue: A French-language website does not establish that programme delivery is in French. The programme-language phrase exceeds the observed evidence.

evidence.observation: French page describes science/engineering commercialization and programmes; an English-language site option is also present.

findings.proposed_fix: Say that the official French-language website describes Centech programmes supporting science and engineering ventures from validation to commercialization. Leave programme delivery language unknown.
findings.root_resolution: Agreed by root: report will identify French-language website review; programme delivery language remains unknown.

findings.issue: Montreal is stored as the sole structured HQ object while the basis correctly describes North American and European regional headquarters. A flat projection can lose the qualification and Berlin location.

evidence.observation: Company offices section identifies North American and European headquarters and lists Montreal and Berlin.

findings.proposed_fix: Preserve scope:North America for Montreal and structured additional_headquarters/locations for Berlin, Germany, scoped Europe. Do not infer sole global HQ or incorporation from either address.

findings.issue: The investor release directly names Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as the investing actor and says the investment was made under its Social Value Creation Investment Fund. A distinct legal fund entity has not been established by the sources read.

evidence.observation: SMBC announces its investment under the named fund; terms undisclosed.
Linked establishment announcement describes a group investment framework and allocated capital; no separate legal fund identity is specified.

findings.proposed_fix: Use Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as the supported investing actor and retain Social Value Creation Investment Fund as the stated fund/framework context. Alternatively mark fund legal identity unresolved. Do not count bank and framework twice.

findings.issue: The phrase Public company identity may be misread as listed-company status, which the cited identity and headquarters evidence does not establish.
findings.proposed_fix: Change to Publicly documented company identity or Official company identity. Do not classify a company as publicly traded from this wording.
